name: TeamStarWolf - OWASP Top 10 (2021)
description: Curated practitioner view of the OWASP Top 10 (2021) themes used in SECURE_CODING_REFERENCE.md, not an official OWASP or MITRE mapping. The 2021 edition is intentional and is not a claim to represent the latest Top 10. Sources: that reference's A01-A10 sections and data/attack/technique_profiles.jsonl. Associations describe possible attacker behavior or defensive context, not equivalence between a weakness category and an ATT&CK technique. Scores indicate membership only.

techniques.comment: A01:2021 Broken Access Control: the reference associates valid-account abuse with access-control failures; using an account alone does not establish a weakness. Sources: SECURE_CODING_REFERENCE.md.

A02:2021 Cryptographic Failures and A10:2021 SSRF: the reference associates exposed credential material and cloud metadata credential access with these themes. Sources: SECURE_CODING_REFERENCE.md.
A02:2021 Cryptographic Failures: network sniffing can exploit unprotected traffic; the weakness and the act of sniffing are distinct. Sources: SECURE_CODING_REFERENCE.md.

A03:2021 Injection: injection into a public-facing application can support application exploitation. Sources: SECURE_CODING_REFERENCE.md.
A04:2021 Insecure Design and A07:2021 Identification and Authentication Failures: inadequate authentication defenses can permit brute-force attempts. Sources: SECURE_CODING_REFERENCE.md.
A04:2021 Insecure Design: resource exhaustion can cause endpoint denial of service. Sources: SECURE_CODING_REFERENCE.md.
A05:2021 Security Misconfiguration: exposed host or software information can aid reconnaissance. Sources: SECURE_CODING_REFERENCE.md.

A06:2021 Vulnerable and Outdated Components and A08:2021 Software and Data Integrity Failures: supply-chain compromise is relevant when dependencies or delivery are tampered with; outdated components alone do not establish this technique. Sources: SECURE_CODING_REFERENCE.md.
A06:2021 Vulnerable and Outdated Components: exploiting vulnerable client software can lead to client execution. Sources: SECURE_CODING_REFERENCE.md.
A07:2021 Identification and Authentication Failures: weak session protection can expose web session cookies to theft. Sources: SECURE_CODING_REFERENCE.md.
A08:2021 Software and Data Integrity Failures: unsafe interpreter use can turn untrusted code or data into command execution. Sources: SECURE_CODING_REFERENCE.md.

A09:2021 Security Logging and Monitoring Failures: the reference associates indicator removal with audit visibility; missing logging alone is not indicator removal. Sources: SECURE_CODING_REFERENCE.md.

A10:2021 SSRF: the reference offers a proxy association. This applies to a command-and-control scenario only when the abused service actually relays that traffic; SSRF alone is not equivalent to ATT&CK Proxy. Sources: SECURE_CODING_REFERENCE.md.
